name: H3 Regenerate 2K IC
summary: Regenerates a 768p H3 draft at 1080p, 2K or 4K with the Open-H3-Regenerate-2K-IC in-context refiner.

inputs.label: 768p draft
inputs.help: A 768p-class H3 draft. The draft stays in context while the IC LoRA regenerates it at the selected size.

inputs.label: Draft caption (optional)
inputs.help: Usually leave this empty. The original prompt often contains reference tags (<Picture N>, <Video N>, <Audio N>) and instructions that the 2K IC pass cannot see; <Video 1> is the draft here. A scene-only caption is safer; reference-specific prompts can harm fidelity.

inputs.label: Output size
inputs.help: Actual dimensions follow the draft aspect ratio. 4K is gated by available GPU memory.

inputs.label: Sampler
inputs.help: up3 and up4 use the 3D latent upscaler; hf8 starts from noise and runs all eight HyperFlow steps.

inputs.label: LMS Sharp
inputs.help: LMS Sharp strength. 0 disables the sharpening LoRA.

inputs.label: Decoder
inputs.help: Fast VAE is the default for 1080p/2K. 4K automatically selects the standard H3 VAE. Selecting fast at 4K is blocked.

notes: Draft frontend for the separate Open-H3-Regenerate-2K-IC sidecar. The exact latent upscaler and sigma grid are not exposed by SGLang; wire this app to the sidecar when the IC image is baked.
